set system host-name CE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching interface-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode access
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.explanation: Configure the interface as an ethnet exchange mode and set the interface mode as an access mode.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

delete interfaces ge-0/0/1 disable.explanation: Deletes the disablement status of the interface and allows the interface to be enabled.
